name: WA TAFE concession fee rate (30% of tuition)
summary: Eligible WA TAFE students on JobSeeker, Youth Allowance, Austudy or ABSTUDY, or aged 15 to 24, pay a reduced concession rate on tuition.
key: If you're eligible, you will pay 30% of the tuition fees.
who: Students receiving JobSeeker, Youth Allowance, Austudy or ABSTUDY with a valid concession card
Students aged 15 to 24 enrolled in a certificate course, or a Lower Fees, Local Skills diploma or advanced diploma
Dependants of a Health Care Card, Pensioner Concession Card or DVA Repatriation Health Benefits Card holder
how: Show a valid concession card when you enrol.
catches: No concession is given for resource or other fees.

evidence.quote: If you're eligible, you will pay 30% of the tuition fees.
To claim the concession rate, you must provide a valid concession card at the time you enrol.
If you're 15 to 24 years old you may be entitled to a concession once enrolled in a certificate level course
